cds.title: Texas A&M University-Kingsville Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF; latest edition posted, fall 2024 class)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2024 first-years; the 2024-2025 edition is the newest on tamuk.edu/pes): 8,846 applied, 8,043 admitted (90.9%), 1,286 enrolled. International: 32 applied, 30 admitted, 5 enrolled; 6 applicants of unknown residency. No waitlist, no early decision or early action. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column (C11); average GPA 3.43 is C12. Class rank (C10, 94% reporting): top tenth 12%, top quarter 39%. SAT submitters 348 (27%), ACT 115 (9%). Undergraduate enrollment 5,386 and 72 nonresidents are B2 total undergraduates. Student-faculty ratio 18:1 is CDS I-2.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2026): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'. C8F: a composite ACT of 19 or a combined SAT of 1000 meets the admission requirement.

cost.notes: CDS G1 (first-year, 2025-26; the CDS ticks that final 2025-26 costs were not yet available): in-state tuition $5,137, nonresident tuition $18,133, required fees $4,755, on-campus food and housing $10,823 (housing $6,400 + meal plan $4,423). G5 (residents): books $1,190, transportation $1,315, other $2,007 (other_usd = transportation + other). Per-credit-hour: $171 resident, $604 nonresident. H6: 17 degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates received institutional aid, average $1,522 (total $25,867).
